title: 🧹 Janitor: Remove redundant importmap from index.html
body:
### 🗑️ What
Removed the redundant `<script type="importmap">` block from `index.html`.

### 💡 Why
The block contained stale library references, including the already-deprecated `@google/genai` provider. Since this is a Vite-based project, dependencies are managed via `package.json` and bundled at build time, rendering the manual browser-side import map unnecessary and potentially confusing.

### 📉 Impact
- Reduced `index.html` size.
- Removed structural inconsistency and stale provider references.
- Clarified that the project relies on Vite's bundling rather than manual import maps.
